summary: ACRES Commercial Realty Corp. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an Agreement and Plan of Merger to acquire its external manager, ACRES Capital Corp., through a merger with a subsidiary, resulting in internalization of management. The consideration is the issuance of common stock, subject to stockholder approval; no explicit price per share or premium is stated. A special committee of independent directors approved the deal, advised by BTIG, LLC, which provided a fairness opinion. The merger agreement requires stockholder approval and other conditions. Watch for stockholder vote timing and any dissenting shareholder activity; the risk-arb angle centers on shareholder approval and post-closing internalization benefits.
